topic: Bayes' Theorem and Independence: Unlocking Probability

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Conditional Probability & Visual Logic
lecture_lines: Conditional probability: P(A|B) narrows our universe.
Consider our total sample space, S.
Subset B acts as our new reality.
The intersection represents occurrences of A given B.
Example: Orange animal reduces our animal cage set.
animations: Fade in text 'P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)' in white #FFFFFF.
Highlight intersection area in light blue #ADD8E6 within Venn diagram.
Animate shrinking 'B' circle to demonstrate P(B) as denominator.
Flash P(A ∩ B) label #FFFFE0 to emphasize numerator.
Fade in 'Evidence changes our belief' text #F0F8FF.

sections.title: Independence: The 'No Influence' Condition
lecture_lines: Independence: Knowing B provides zero info about A.
Mathematically, this means P(A|B) equals P(A).
Imagine a coin flip and a spinning wheel.
animations: Fade in two independent sets A and B as separate circles.
Animate B moving without changing A's size to show independence.

sections.title: Bayes' Theorem: The Logic of Reversing Evidence
lecture_lines: Bayes' Theorem: Reversing the logic of evidence.
We calculate P(A|B) using the likelihood.
It connects P(B|A) back to our original prior.
This updates our belief with new data.
Crucial for real-world smart device accuracy.
animations: Display 'P(A|B) = P(B|A) * P(A) / P(B)' in white #FFFFFF.
Highlight P(B|A) term in yellow #FFFF00 for emphasis.
Show transition from prior to posterior using an arrow #FFFFFF.
Flash P(B) label #FFC0CB to indicate normalization factor.
Fade in visual balance scale icon comparing prior and posterior.

sections.title: Synthesis & Real-world Application
lecture_lines: Synthesizing: Prior, Evidence, and Posterior probability.
Bayes' updates certainty in the face of uncertainty.
Testing example: Prior prevalence informs posterior diagnosis.
animations: Fade in text 'Medical Diagnosis Example' in white #FFFFFF.
Display test sensitivity and false positive rates.
Animate final probability calculation with bold result #00FF00.
